units.source_text: 此时有一位被世人遗忘了的老年亲王。

en.t: At that time there was an elderly prince whom the world had forgotten.

units.source_text: 他母亲也出身于高贵之家。

en.t: His mother, too, came from a noble family.

units.source_text: 他幼时本有当皇太子的声望，只因后来时势变迁，纠纷突起，使他陷于困境，反而弄得一事无成。

en.t: In his childhood he had once been regarded as a likely crown prince, but later, as the times changed and disputes suddenly arose, he was driven into hardship and ended up accomplishing nothing.

units.source_text: 做他后援人的诸外戚苦恨之余，各自推故出家为僧。

en.t: The maternal relatives who had supported him, bitter and resentful, each found a pretext and entered the priesthood as monks.

units.source_text: 这皇子在公私两方都失去依靠，就成了孤独之状。

en.t: Having lost support in both public and private life, this prince was left in a state of loneliness.

units.source_text: 他的夫人也是前代大臣的女儿，回想当初父母对她的指望，无限伤心，悲痛之事甚多。

en.t: His wife was also the daughter of a minister of the previous generation; when she thought back on the hopes her parents had once placed in her, she was endlessly grieved, and there were many sorrows for her to lament.

units.source_text: 全靠夫妻恩爱无比，聊可慰藉人世忧患，两人彼此信赖，相依为命。

en.t: Only their incomparable affection as husband and wife gave them some comfort amid the troubles of the world; trusting one another, the two lived by depending on each other.
